plugin.name: Knight Rider 2 Fusion Fix
ResX.description: Output width in pixels. Zero uses the desktop resolution. Takes effect after a restart.
ResY.description: Output height in pixels. Zero uses the desktop resolution. Takes effect after a restart.
FOVFactor.description: Multiplies the corrected field of view. 1.0 keeps the intended framing; larger values widen the view. Applies immediately. Gameplay only; story cameras keep their original framing.
WindowMode.description: Fullscreen uses the chosen resolution. Windowed keeps an exact picture area at that resolution. Borderless covers the monitor at its desktop resolution. Restart the game to apply.
SkipIntro.description: Skips the startup legal and logo sequence. Mission scenes and story content remain available. Restart the game to apply.
HudAspectRatioConstraint.description: Auto keeps the HUD at the screen edges. A ratio keeps it in a centred box of that shape.
MAIN.TextLanguage.description: Language used for the fix settings in compatible editors. Auto follows the game when available, otherwise the editor language.
MAIN.ConfineCursor.description: Keeps the cursor inside the active game window. Releases it on focus loss, while moving the window or using a system menu, and immediately when disabled.
FPSLimit.description: Maximum frames per second. 0 is unlimited, -1 follows the monitor refresh rate, and positive values are limited to 30–1000. Applies immediately.
CutsceneBorders.description: Preserves the original story camera framing with side borders. Off shows a wider view. Applies immediately.
CheckForUpdates.description: Checks for a newer fix when enabled. A notice appears at the main menu. FusionFixHub opens the update page after the game exits, when installed beside the game. Disabled by default.
update.availablehub: A new {name} version is available. Update it in FusionFixHub after closing the game.
update.availablesite: A new {name} version is available at fusionfix.io.
GamepadIcons.description: Button names in Options > Controls and menu footers follow the last input device. Auto uses Xbox names. Xbox, PlayStation and Nintendo labels match the bundled Xidi layout. Applies immediately.
SkipPressStart.description: Continues past the startup Press Start screen automatically. Restart the game to apply.
FMVWidescreenMode.description: Original fits the whole video inside the original 4:3 presentation. Fill preserves the picture and skips the black borders encoded in the intro and new game videos.
